purpose: Seek additional confirmation evidence without mislabeling reused development inputs as independent validation. Stage sequence inputs and audit overlap only; do not evaluate accuracy until a candidate method and protocol are frozen.
authors_declared_origin: 17 proteomes from QfO 2019, with simplified sequence names. This makes species and protein reuse plausible despite renamed identifiers.
sequence_rule: Reuse the established YGOB overlap fingerprint: uppercase amino-acid sequence and remove one terminal translation stop; preserve internal stops, gaps, and ambiguous residues. Report this normalization explicitly; identifier renaming must not defeat the audit.
admission: Any matching candidate sequence rules out strict sequence-disjoint confirmation. Lack of exact matches does not establish species, gene-family, label, or evolutionary independence. Do not select subsets based on accuracy outcomes. Newer QfO releases are annotation-update robustness candidates, not automatically independent datasets.
reference_label_policy: Do not download, read, or score reference_classification.txt, OG alignments, family trees, or precomputed predictions in this staging audit. Validate reference/scoring semantics and redistribution permissions separately if the dataset is subsequently used.
implementation: Read ZIP members as streams without extracting paths or executing upstream code; reject unsafe archive paths, encryption, duplicate member names, empty or invalid FASTA inputs; hash all archives and development FASTAs before and after the audit.
limitations: This audits sequence exposure, not inferred orthology accuracy or benchmark reference quality.
All previously evaluated YGOB and simulation panels remain development-exposed.
Novel random seeds can support confirmation conditional on a simulator, but do not establish independent biological generalization.
Public availability alone does not establish permission to redistribute dataset bytes; keep raw archives local and commit provenance rather than proteomes.
Missing suitable independent reference data remains nonblocking for development hill-climbing; disclose that limitation rather than inventing independence.
git: Commit and push the plan and tested audit implementation before the audit; then retain and push verified acquisition, overlap, and interpretation receipts. Production defaults are unchanged.
